His wife found him unconscious on the bathroom floor. He regained consciousness after about 30 seconds without any confusion or amnesia for the event. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the onset immediately after urination is a significant clue. Have you experienced similar episodes in the past, and do you have a history of heart disease or high blood pressure? REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Commotio Cordis / Situational Syncope secondary to micturition syncope (likely vasovagal). The timing (syncope immediately after urination in an older male) combined with a normal ECG and echocardiogram strongly suggests a reflex-mediated drop in blood pressure rather than a primary cardiac arrhythmia or structural heart disease. Given the normal workup for structural and electrical heart disease, the most probable diagnosis is micturition syncope, where the act of voiding triggers a vagal response leading to transient cerebral hypoperfusion. I will confirm this by asking if you have a history of similar fainting episodes or if you feel dizzy upon standing quickly. REQUEST TEST: Orthostatic_Blood_Pressure
